name: wuhua-tianwang-poker
description: 梅州五华天王扑克：前后端分仓，依赖各自装在 client/ 与 server/。

scripts.android:build: cd client && npm run build && cd .. && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && mkdir -p releases && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk releases/wuhuatianwang-android.apk
scripts.android:debug: cd client && npm run build && cd .. && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
